issues.failure_explanation: In Eq. (3), the $z$-th summand of the Racah formula has denominator $\prod_{i=1}^4 [z - a_i]_q! \prod_{y=1}^3 [b_y - z]_q!$. The consecutive term ratio $T_{z+1}/T_z$ is therefore $- \frac{[z+2]_q \prod_{y=1}^3 [b_y - z]_q}{\prod_{i=1}^4 [z+1-a_i]_q}$. In Eq. (14), the product over $i$ and the product over $y$ are erroneously swapped between numerator and denominator. Furthermore, the argument in the denominator is shifted to $b_y - (z+1)$; because $z_{\max} = \min_y(b_y)$, at the upper boundary index $z = z_{\max} - 1$ the denominator contains $[b_y - z_{\max}]_q = [0]_q = 0$, causing division by zero.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the formula in Eq. (14) with $\mathcal{R}_z = - \frac{[z+2]_q \prod_{y=1}^3 [b_y - z]_q}{\prod_{i=1}^4 [z+1-a_i]_q}$.
issues.overall_effect: The explicit recurrence ratio $\mathcal{R}_z$ is mathematically incorrect and ill-defined at $z = z_{\max}-1$. Downstream, step 7 of Algorithm 1 (Deferred cyclotomic compilation) depends on this formula, causing the resulting sequence of update ratios in the DCR representation to diverge or compute the wrong amplitudes for the quantum $6j$-symbol.
issues.title: Inverted factors and division by zero in the recurrence ratio formula for the quantum 6j-symbol
issues.why_classification: This is a routine local correction directly derived from the summand definition in Eq. (3). Repairing the ratio formula fixes the recurrence update in Algorithm 1 without requiring any new lemmas, proof architecture, or changes to the stated complexity and stability guarantees.
